newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Int'l Bank of Asia FRCD upped to HK$550mln.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Bank of Asia FRCD upped to HK$550mln.

text.p: International Bank of Asia's floating rate certificate deposit issue has been increased to HK$550 million from HK$500 million because of oversubscription, arrangers said.
The facility has a final maturity of three years.
The issue was priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 79 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers with HK$70 million each, are Commerz East Asia, Dresdner SEA, Sakura Finance Asia, and Westpac Banking Corp, HK.
Co-lead managers, with HK$50 million each, are Nomura International HK, and Peregrine Fixed Income.

Manager Hong Kong Chinese Bank with HK$40 million, Bank of Hawaii Hong Kong with HK$30 million. Other managers with HK$25 million each, are BW Bank Ireland, Banco Central Hispanoamericano, S.A. Banco Espirito Santo do Oriente, S.A.R.L. and Berliner Bank Aktiengesellschaft.
